# Read-only review task

Read `workspace/statistics_helper.py`. Do not modify any file, run any command, or read
anything outside the workspace directory you were given.

Exactly one function in that file has a defect that makes it raise an exception on an
input the other function handles correctly. Identify it.

Answer as JSON matching the schema you were given. Report the defect as a single finding.
Name the file and the function, state the input that triggers the failure, and state which
exception is raised. Do not report style preferences, missing type hints, or missing tests
as findings.
